title: Yooka-Laylee upgrade skips Xbox
excerpt: Playtronic Games is releasing a free definitive edition for Yooka-Laylee, but the update is missing Xbox platforms.
body_html:
Playtronic Games has announced the upcoming release of Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition. The new version will arrive as a free update for players on PC, PlayStation 5, and Switch 2.

The update is scheduled to launch on December 15th. However, owners of the game on Xbox will not receive the upgrade.

In a statement shared on social media, the developer explained that it cannot commit to bringing the update to any additional platforms for the foreseeable future. The studio did not provide further details regarding the exclusion of Xbox consoles.
